result_summary.title: Token Service failures in EU-Central - Looks like resource exhaustion
result_summary.description: Users in the EU-Central region are reporting that MFA codes are being rejected, password reset links are expiring too quickly, and there are mismatches in the federation metadata. 33 users are affected. We have monitored the server metrics and seen spikes in memory and CPU usage during these incidents. We think it's because of resource exhaustion on the token generation nodes causing these timeouts and invalid responses. Please scale the resources.
